description_en: Queries the historical tasks that are created within 30 days
description_zh: 该接口用于获取历史任务记录，支持创建时间30天内的任务
name: DescribeHistoryTasks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the pending event. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 待处理事件所属的地域ID，可调用DescribeRegions接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：10~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果的页码。取值范围：正整数。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Scheduled
Running
Succeed
Failed
Cancelling
Canceled
Waiting

Separate multiple values with commas (,). By default, this parameter is left empty, which indicates that tasks in all statuses are queried
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，取值说明：
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Failed：执行失败
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间

如需查询多个状态则用英文逗号分隔，默认为空，表示全选
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 instance IDs. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that you can specify an unlimited number of instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，用于查询对应实例的任务，如有多个用英文逗号分隔，最多支持30个，默认为空，表示不限制
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can call the DescribeTasks operation to query the task ID. If multiple task IDs exist, separate them with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 task IDs. By default, this parameter is left empty, which indicates that all tasks are queried
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，可调用DescribeTasks接口获取。如有多个任务ID，使用英文用逗号分隔，最多支持30个，默认为空，表示不限制
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The task type. Separate multiple task types with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 task types. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that you can specify an unlimited number of task types
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，用于查询特定类型任务情况，如有多个用英文逗号分隔，最多支持30个，默认为空，表示不限制
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Only tasks that have a start time later than or equal to the time specified by this parameter are queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The start time can be up to 30 days earlier than the current time. If you set this parameter to a time more than 30 days earlier than the current time, the specified time is automatically converted to a time that is exactly 30 days earlier than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的起始时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之后的任务。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。最早支持30天前，距当前时间超过30天会自动转换成30天前
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Only tasks that have a start time earlier than or equal to the time specified by this parameter are queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的结束时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之前的任务。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: to_start_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum execution duration of the task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is longer than the minimum execution duration. Unit: seconds. The default value is 0, which indicates that no limit is imposed
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最小值。用于筛选任务执行耗时大于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: from_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum execution duration of a task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is shorter than or equal to the maximum execution duration. Unit: seconds. The default value is 0, which indicates that no limit is imposed
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最大值。用于筛选任务执行耗时不小于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: to_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

CallerSource.description_en: The ID of the user who made the request. If CallerSource is set to User, CallerUid indicates the unique ID (UID) of the user
CallerSource.description_zh: 请求用户ID，callerSource为User时代表用户UID

CallerUid.description_en:
The source of the request. Valid values:

System
User
CallerUid.description_zh:
请求来源，取值说明：
System：系统
User：用户

CurrentStepName.description_en: The name of the current step. If this parameter is left empty, the task is not started
CurrentStepName.description_zh: 当前执行的步骤名，如果为空代表任务未开始

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the task

ReasonCode.description_en: The reason why the current task was initiated

RemainTime.description_en: The estimated amount of time remaining to complete the task. Unit: seconds
RemainTime.description_zh: 预估剩余执行时间，单位为秒（s）

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the task

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Scheduled
Running
Succeed
Failed
Cancelling
Canceled
Waiting
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Failed：执行失败
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间

Uid.description_en: The ID of the user to which the resources belong

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. If the request fails, provide this ID for technical support to troubleshoot the failure
RequestId.description_zh: 请求唯一ID，如果遇到问题请提供这个请求ID，由工作人员为您排查

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tasks that meet these constraints without taking pagination into account
TotalCount.description_zh: 不考虑分页因素，满足这些限制条件的总任务数
